title: 第6章  苏家苏扬，看你不爽！
content_zh:
“客人，这里就是我天宝楼的炼丹场所了。”
青衣侍女领着方玄，顺着通道走进一个大厅。
大厅中，飘散着浓郁的丹香和炙热的气息。
除此之外，还有不少人等候在这里，彼此交谈着，倒是颇为热闹。
“这么多人？”
方玄眉头一皱。
“客人有所不知。”
青衣侍女解释道：“这些人，都是来请明大师炼制丹药的客人。”
青衣侍女继续说道：“明大师可是我天宝楼聘请的二品炼丹师，炼丹术极为高超，每日求他炼丹之人不计其数。”
“不过明大师精力有限，每日只会为三人炼丹，这些人，大多注定要失望而归了。”
方玄暗自咋舌。
二品炼丹师，品阶看似不高。
但在这小小的青阳郡，也算得上是一方人物了。
便是如方家之流，也不敢轻易得罪这样的人物。
因为，炼丹师最令人忌惮的是，正是他们那令人恐惧的召唤力。
可以说，整个青阳郡，但凡是有头有脸的大人物，谁没请明大师炼过丹？
得罪了这么一位存在，那就是和整个青阳郡的大家族、大人物作对。
不过，方玄获得丹鼎女帝的炼丹传承，二品炼丹师对他来说，唾手可得。
“明大师来了！”
在方玄脑海中念头转动之时，惊呼声响起，让他连忙抬头看去。

只见一名红袍老者缓缓走来。
他须发如火，龙行虎步，周身萦绕着一股雄浑的炙热气息。
一双虎目环视之间，竟然给人一种如同直面火山的灼热感。
方玄双目微微一眯，心中惊叹。
没想到这位明大师，不仅是一位二品炼丹师，还是一位修为高深的武道强者。
“想必老夫的规矩大家都知道吧？”
明大师笑呵呵的说道：“和往常一样，三个名额，先到先得。”
“我我我。”
一名年轻人迫不及待冲上前去，将几份药材递给明大师。
“明大师，还有我。”
又有一名中年男子，将一个储物袋递给明大师，谄媚着道：“这里面是炼制丹药的药材，还有报酬，还请明大师莫要嫌弃啊。”
“恳请明大师，为我炼制一枚清心丹，这是丹方和药材。”
第三人上前，同样将一个储物袋，递交上去。
除了这三人之外，陆续有人上前，恳求明大师为他们炼制丹药。
“都别急都别急。”
被这么多人围着，明大师也不恼，笑呵呵的说道：“虽说是先到先得，但也要看老夫心情。”
“是是是，是我等唐突了，还请明大师见谅。”
众人连忙赔礼道歉，但脸上的殷切，却是毫不掩饰。
都希望明大师选中自己。
看着眼前的这些求丹之人，明大师面带笑容，先后挑了两人。

就在他正要挑选第三人的时候，一道略显傲然的声音蓦地响起。
“苏家苏扬，求明大师炼丹。”
随着话音落下，三道身影缓缓走来。
率先一人，年纪不大，但满脸傲然。
鼻孔朝天的模样，毫不将所有人放在眼里。
他身后两人，体型魁梧，气息强大，看样子像是护卫。
而在此人出现的瞬间，方玄眼中却是猛然闪过一抹凛然杀意。
苏清瑶的弟弟。
仗着自己的姐姐苏清瑶，苏扬可没少向方玄索要好处。
当初的方玄，眼盲心瞎，对苏扬的一切无理要求，从未拒绝。
而在方玄痴傻三年中，苏扬更是多次欺辱方玄。
包括他被苏清瑶哄骗到断魂崖，同样有苏扬的手笔。
再见仇人，方玄恨不得将苏扬挫骨扬灰。
但他知道，现在不是出手的时候。
苏扬径直拨开人群，走到明大师面前。
手一伸，一名护卫连忙将一个储物袋递过来。
“明大师，这里面是三种丹药的药材，希望明大师能够尽快炼制出来，我等着急用。”
语气看似客气，实则带着一丝命令的意味。
“苏家的人，还真是霸道。”
有人不满的质疑道：“让明大师帮你一人炼制三种丹药，你是要累死明大师吗？”

“就是。明大师如今只有一个名额，最多也只能帮你炼制一枚丹药。”
“小声点吧，自从苏家苏清瑶，被问道宗收为弟子，苏家的地位也随之水涨船高，更是以青阳郡第一家族自居。这苏扬可是苏清瑶的弟弟，得罪了他，有你好受的。”
听着这些质疑声，苏扬脸上的笑容越发浓郁。
他看向其中一人，说道：“说得不错。既然如此，那今日明大师的三个名额，我苏扬都要了。”
这番话语，比之前更加霸道强势，也让人更加反感。
“凭什么？”
被明大师选中的一人，当即反驳道：“明大师的规矩，先到先得，就算你是苏家人，也要按明大师的规矩来。”
“规矩？”
苏扬嘴角一咧，直接一巴掌将那人抽飞出去。
“我苏家的规矩就是规矩！”
苏扬揉着手腕，说道：“不服？你大可试试！”
“你敢动手打人？简直太目中无人了！”
另外一人，也大声呵斥，满脸愤怒。
“莫说打人，就算把你杀了，又能如何？”
苏扬脸色一狞，挥手道：“给本少爷把他废了！”
那人被吓得连连后退，面露惊恐。
其他人更是噤若寒蝉，大气都不敢喘。
苏家，可不是他们能够得罪的庞然大物。
“你们太过分了。”
青衣侍女上前一步，冷声呵斥道：“这里是天宝楼，你们敢在这里动手？”

“有什么不敢的？”
苏扬嗤笑一声，说道：“小贱人，别挡路，否则连你一块儿打！”
“我劝你适可而止。”
青衣侍女张开手，固执的说道：“否则等管事大人来了，就让你吃不了兜着走！”
“哟嗬，口气还真不小。”
苏扬眼神狠厉：“你不过一个卑贱的下人而已，也敢威胁本少爷？你怕是活得不耐烦了！”
说罢，苏扬扬起手，直接朝着青衣侍女抽了下去。
青衣侍女本就毫无修为，顿时被吓得闭上眼睛。
“嘭！”
但是下一刻，苏扬的手腕顿时被一只手掌牢牢抓住。
无论苏扬如何用力，竟然都无法挣脱。
他心中猛然一惊。
他可是造血境巅峰的修为，竟然连手都无法i抽回。
难道对方是炼体境？
“你......你敢拦我？”
苏扬脸色一变，双眼死死瞪着方玄：“小子，你也活腻了吗？”
“苏家还真是一代不如一代了。”
方玄淡淡的说道：“怎么尽出你这种仗势欺人的垃圾。”
“住口！”
方玄的话，像是刺激了苏扬，令他脸色扭曲。

“小杂种，你算个什么东西，也敢羞辱我苏家？信不信我......”
不等苏扬把话说完，方玄眼中寒芒一闪，一脚踹在苏扬的腹部，将其踢飞了出去。
“哇！”
苏扬摔在地上，当场喷出一口鲜血。
这一幕，令在场众人震惊不已。
这小子什么来头，竟然敢对苏家人出手？
不想活了吗？
“小杂种，我要宰了你！”
苏扬面色狰狞，怒吼道：“废物，你们还愣着做什么？给本少爷杀了他！”
苏扬带来的两名护卫，闻言连忙齐齐冲向方玄。
“放肆！”
就在此时，一声清脆的冷喝声猛然响起。
“我天宝楼，何时轮得到你苏家人在此撒野了！”
伴随声音而起的，是一道令人惊恐的磅礴气息。
两名护卫，直接被一股恐怖的力量掀飞出去。
同时口喷鲜血，身受重伤。
这突如其来的一幕，顿时令在场众人一惊。
在所有人惊疑不定之时，一名女子款款走来，无形的威压，顿时将整个炼丹大厅笼罩。
而众人的呼吸，也随着女子的出现，蓦地一窒。
只见此女身着酒红色旗袍，烈焰红唇，眸含桃花，像是一朵带刺的娇艳玫瑰。

诱人，却又充满危险。
但方玄仅仅只是扫了一眼，便快速的收回视线。
此女模样气质确实不俗，但与和他有过几夜风流的秦洛璃相比，却是略有不如。
更别说，那九位风华绝代的女帝了。
方玄的动作虽然微弱，却被旗袍女子敏锐的察觉到，让她眼底不由得露出一抹诧异之色。
她对别人的视线打量很是敏感，其中一些不怀好意的目光，更是让她本能的厌恶。
但是那名明显刻意乔装过的少年，眼神清澈，毫无杂质。
“好干净的眼神。”
蓝媚儿有些惊讶。
这种干净到纯粹的眼神，她还是第一次见到。
真是个有趣的小家伙。
不过，蓝媚儿没有多想，眼神径直落在苏扬身上。
“就是你在我天宝楼的地盘上出手伤人？当真是好大的胆子！”
那冰冷的视线，和冷漠的语气，强大的气场，让苏扬不由得有些心虚。
但一想到自己的身份，苏扬便一挺胸膛，梗着脖子道：“不错，正是我。”
“我可是苏家人，难道你敢动我不成？”
语气之中，带着强烈的自信。
“苏家？”
蓝媚儿红唇翘起，带着与生俱来的孤傲。
“很了不起吗？”

话音落下，蓝媚儿周身气息释放，将苏扬震飞出去，再次口喷鲜血。
“带着你的狗，滚出这里。”
蓝媚儿冷声道：“若有下次，你苏家上下，休想踏入我天宝楼一步。”
“凭什么？”
苏扬指着方玄，声嘶力竭的怒吼道：“他也动手了，凭什么只把我赶出去？”
蓝媚儿轻笑一声，言语平淡。
“因为，老娘看你不爽！”
content_en:
"Guest, this is my alchemy place in Tianbao Tower."
The maid in green led Fang Xuan down the passage into a hall.
In the hall, there is a strong fragrance of red pills and a hot breath.
In addition, there are many people waiting here, talking to each other, which is quite lively.
"So many people?"
Fang Xuan frowned.
"The guests don't know something."
The maid in blue explained: "These people are all guests who came to ask Master Ming to refine the elixir."
The maid in green clothes continued: "Master Ming is a second-grade alchemist hired by our Tianbao Tower. He is extremely skilled in alchemy. Countless people ask him to make alchemy every day."
"However, Master Ming has limited energy and can only refine elixirs for three people every day. Most of these people are destined to be disappointed."
Fang Xuan was secretly speechless.
A second-grade alchemist whose rank does not seem to be high.
But in this small Qingyang County, he can be regarded as a person.
Even people like the Fang family would not dare to offend such a person easily.
Because what is most feared about alchemists is their terrifying summoning power.
It can be said that in the entire Qingyang County, among all the prominent figures, who has not asked Master Ming to refine elixirs?
To offend such a being is to go against the entire big family and important figures in Qingyang County.
However, Fang Xuan obtained the alchemy inheritance from Empress Alchemy Cauldron, and a second-grade alchemist was easily accessible to him.
"Master Ming is here!"
As the thoughts in Fang Xuan's mind were turning, a cry of surprise sounded, causing him to quickly look up.
I saw an old man in red robe walking slowly.
His beard and hair were like fire, he walked like a dragon and tiger, and there was a powerful and hot aura lingering around him.
A pair of tiger eyes looked around, giving people a burning feeling like facing a volcano.
Fang Xuan narrowed his eyes slightly and marveled in his heart.
Unexpectedly, Master Ming was not only a second-grade alchemist, but also a powerful martial artist with profound cultivation.
"I guess everyone knows my rules, right?"
Master Ming said with a smile: "As usual, there are three places, first come, first served."
"Me me me."
A young man rushed forward impatiently and handed several medicinal materials to Master Ming.
"Master Ming, and me."
Another middle-aged man handed a storage bag to Master Ming and said flatteringly: "This contains the medicinal materials for refining the elixir, and there is also a reward. Master Ming, please don't dislike it."
"I beg Master Ming to refine a Qingxin Pill for me. Here are the prescriptions and medicinal materials."
The third person stepped forward and handed over a storage bag as well.
In addition to these three people, people came forward one after another and begged Master Ming to refine elixirs for them.
"Don't be in a hurry, don't be in a hurry."
Being surrounded by so many people, Master Ming was not annoyed and said with a smile: "Although it is first come, first served, it also depends on my mood."
"Yes, yes, I was rude, please forgive me, Master Ming."
Everyone apologized quickly, but the earnestness on their faces was undisguised.
They all hope that Master Ming will choose them.
Looking at the people seeking elixirs in front of him, Master Ming smiled and picked two of them one after another.
Just when he was about to choose the third person, a slightly proud voice suddenly sounded.
"Su Yang of the Su family, please ask Master Ming to make elixirs."
As the words fell, three figures slowly walked over.
The first person was young, but his face was full of pride.
With his nostrils turned upward, he did not look down upon anyone.
The two people behind him were tall and powerful, and they looked like guards.
But the moment this person appeared, a flash of awe-inspiring killing intent suddenly flashed in Fang Xuan's eyes.
Su Qingyao's younger brother.
Relying on his sister Su Qingyao, Su Yang often asked for benefits from Fang Xuan.
Back then, Fang Xuan was blind and blind, and he never refused any of Su Yang's unreasonable demands.
During the three years that Fang Xuan was stupid, Su Yang even bullied Fang Xuan many times.
Including him being coaxed to Duanhun Cliff by Su Qingyao, Su Yang alsohandwriting.
Seeing his enemy again, Fang Xuan wished he could crush Su Yang to ashes.
But he knew that now was not the time to take action.
Su Yang pushed aside the crowd and walked up to Master Ming.
As soon as he stretched out his hand, a guard quickly handed over a storage bag.
"Master Ming, here are the ingredients for three kinds of elixirs. I hope Master Ming can refine them as soon as possible. I'm waiting for urgent use."
The tone seemed polite, but in fact it had a hint of command.
"The people from the Su family are really domineering."
Someone questioned dissatisfiedly: "If you ask Master Ming to help you refine three kinds of elixirs alone, are you going to exhaust Master Ming to death?"
"That's right. Master Ming only has one quota now, and he can only help you refine one pill at most."
"Keep your voice down. Ever since the Su family's Su Qingyao was accepted as a disciple by the Taoist Sect, the Su family's status has also risen, and they even claim to be the first family in Qingyang County. This Su Yang is Su Qingyao's younger brother. If you offend him, it will be easy for you."
Listening to these questions, the smile on Su Yang's face grew stronger.
He looked at one of them and said, "That's right. In that case, I, Su Yang, will take all three of Master Ming's places today."
These words were more domineering and powerful than before, and also made people more disgusted.
"Why?"
The person selected by Master Ming immediately retorted: "Master Ming's rules are first come, first served. Even if you are from the Su family, you must follow Master Ming's rules."
"Rules?"
Su Yang grinned and slapped the man away.
"The rules of my Su family are the rules!"
Su Yang rubbed his wrist and said, "Don't accept it? You can try it!"
"You dare to hit someone? You are so arrogant!"
Another person also yelled loudly, his face full of anger.
"Don't talk about beating people. Even if I kill you, what will happen?"
Su Yang's face turned grim, and he waved his hand and said, "I will destroy him for you, Master!"
The man was so frightened that he backed away with a look of horror on his face.
Others were even more silent, not even daring to breathe.
The Su family is not a giant that they can offend.
"You are going too far."
The maid in green took a step forward and scolded in a cold voice: "This is Tianbao Tower, you dare to do something here?"
"What's there to be afraid of?"
Su Yang sneered and said, "You little bitch, don't block the way, or I'll beat you too!"
"I advise you to stop."
The maid in green opened her hand and said stubbornly: "Otherwise, when the steward comes, you will be left without food and carrying around!"
"Hey, your tone is really pretty."
Su Yang's eyes were stern: "You are just a lowly servant, but you dare to threaten me? I'm afraid you are impatient with life!"
After saying that, Su Yang raised his hand and struck it directly towards the maid in blue.
The maid in green clothes, who had no cultivation to begin with, was so frightened that she closed her eyes.
"Bang!"
But the next moment, Su Yang's wrist was firmly grasped by a hand.
No matter how hard Su Yang tried, he couldn't break free.
He was suddenly startled.
He was at the peak of the blood-making realm, and he couldn't even withdraw his hand.
Could it be that the other party is in the body refining realm?
"You...you dare to stop me?"
Su Yang's expression changed and he stared at Fang Xuan: "Boy, are you tired of living too?"
"The Su family is really getting worse from generation to generation."
Fang Xuan said calmly: "How can you be such a bully trash like you?"
"Shut up!"
Fang Xuan's words seemed to stimulate Su Yang and made his face twist.
"Little bastard, who do you think you are? You dare to humiliate my Su family? Believe me or not..."
Before Su Yang could finish speaking, Fang Xuan's eyes flashed coldly, and he kicked Su Yang in the abdomen and kicked him away.
"Wow!"
Su Yang fell to the ground and spurted out a mouthful of blood on the spot.
This scene shocked everyone present.
What kind of background does this boy have that he dares to take action against the Su family?
Don’t you want to live??
"You little bastard, I'm going to kill you!"
Su Yang looked ferocious and roared: "Trash, what are you doing standing still? Kill him for me!"
The two guards brought by Su Yang rushed towards Fang Xuan upon hearing this.
"Presumptuous!"
At this moment, a crisp cold drink suddenly sounded.
"In Tianbao Tower, when will it be your Su family's turn to run wild here!"
Accompanying the sound was a frightening majestic aura.
The two guards were directly thrown away by a terrifying force.
At the same time, he spurted blood from his mouth and was seriously injured.
This sudden scene immediately shocked everyone present.
While everyone was in shock and confusion, a woman walked over, and an invisible pressure suddenly enveloped the entire alchemy hall.
And everyone's breath was suddenly suffocated with the appearance of the woman.
I saw this woman wearing a burgundy cheongsam, flaming red lips, and peach blossom eyes, like a delicate rose with thorns.
Tempting, yet dangerous.
But Fang Xuan only glanced at it and quickly looked away.
This woman's appearance and temperament are indeed good, but compared with Qin Luoli, who had a few nights of romance with him, she is slightly inferior.
Not to mention, those nine magnificent empresses.
Although Fang Xuan's movements were weak, they were keenly noticed by the cheongsam woman, causing a look of surprise in her eyes.
She is very sensitive to other people's gazes, and some of the malicious gazes make her instinctively disgusted.
But the young man who had obviously deliberately disguised himself had clear eyes without any impurities.
"Such a clean look."
Lan Meier was a little surprised.
This was the first time she had seen such a clean and pure look.
What a fun little guy.
However, Lan Meier didn't think much, her eyes fell directly on Su Yang.
"You are the one who hurt people on my Tianbao Tower property? You are really brave!"
The cold gaze, the cold tone, and the strong aura made Su Yang feel guilty.
But when he thought of his identity, Su Yang puffed out his chest and said, "Yes, it's me."
"I am from the Su family, how dare you touch me?"
There was strong confidence in his tone.
"Su family?"
Lan Meier's red lips curled up, showing her innate aloofness.
"Is it amazing?"
As soon as the words fell, Lan Meier's aura was released, sending Su Yang flying out and spitting blood again.
"Take your dog and get out of here."
Lan Meier said coldly: "If there is a next time, no one in your Su family will even think of stepping into my Tianbao Tower."
"Why?"
Su Yang pointed at Fang Xuan and roared at the top of his lungs: "He also took action, why did he only drive me out?"
Lan Meier chuckled lightly and spoke calmly.
"Because I don't like you!"
